title: create the renders directory before the UI role starts

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261120-152522-c419, project ork, item S394:

create the renders directory before the UI role starts

Evidence: the first overlay run failed with "open .../tmp/ui-1/renders/note-field-80x24.txt: no such file or directory" and mkdir is not an allowed command
